decisions.reason: The margin analysis still has its own page and draws on the firm's maintained market data, so keeping it costs little while its value as a distinct analytical service is still uncertain.

The withdrawal of the related regional energy tariff line raises some consolidation risk, but the electricity calculator remains a cheap extension of the core tariff database with no clear negative signal.
The area definition tool supports the remaining location-based products on the central platform, so its option value includes complementarities and its upkeep is low.

The site-specific comparison line overlaps with the dropped gas comparison and is only mentioned on the website, which makes it the weakest option, but its low upkeep still justifies keeping it open another year.
